name: Operation Silent Dagger
operational_summary: A covert strike on Blackreach Station, a pirate-controlled deep-space facility, to neutralise a rogue AI research facility embedded within it, eliminate its leadership, and extract intelligence.

participant_refs.equipment_noted: Wrist-mounted pulse accelerator delivering a neural-disrupting pulse.

participant_refs.role: Sentinel-Phantom — infiltrator; compromised the security grid.

participant_refs.equipment_noted: Dual plasma blades for silent close kills.

participant_refs.role: Sentinel-Stalker — comms monitoring, hacking and entry, AI core shutdown support.
participant_refs.equipment_noted: Gauntlet hacking suite interfacing with core systems; triggered a system purge.
Shockwave generator/gauntlet/cannon for localised kinetic blast and crowd clearing.
participant_refs.fate: Killed in action — the operation's sole casualty.

assets_used: Phantom-Class Stealth Frigate — insertion platform using a cloaking array that defeated standard scans.
A pirate gunship in Dock C — seized and used for extraction.
tactics_observed: Thruster short-burst EVA insertion with magnetic boots on the hull.
Controlled breach — a charge used for seamless metal severance rather than a loud explosion.
Optical cloaking plus security-grid disruption, opening a four-minute window before backup triggers.
opposition_profile: Mercenary guards — former Union soldiers turned pirates.
Hardened ex-military officers and rogue AI researchers.
Half-built AI combat drones activated under emergency override, using energy claws.

outcome.objectives: AI research facility destroyed; leadership neutralised; intelligence extracted.
outcome.strategic_effect: Pirate presence in the sector crippled; illegal AI research shut down; Union intelligence gained access to rogue faction communication networks.

cross_record_corroboration: Three committed records already depend on this operation without it existing as an entity. loc_blackreach_station carries a silent_dagger tag and now records the station's destruction by it; org_union_intelligence_bureau records gaining rogue-faction signals access from an operation that crippled pirate presence and shut down illegal AI research; org_sentinel_high_command and the capsules of all five operators reference it by name.

naming_exemption.reason: Operation name "Operation Silent Dagger" preserved verbatim from the committed marshals/sentinel ledger (LEDGER-MISSIONS-0001).

promotion_to_canon.rule: owner standing directive: discovered detail that does not conflict with canon IS canon
promotion_to_canon.basis: Not a new assertion. The operation is fully documented in committed canon — a mission ledger entry with an id, a source, named actors with roles, assets, tactics, opposition, outcome and casualties — and is referenced by org_sentinel_high_command, loc_blackreach_station and five operator capsules. It simply never received an entity record. This is recovery of material the reconstruction dropped, not promotion of a claim.
promotion_to_canon.conflict_scan: No competing event record covers this operation. All eight referenced entities resolve to existing records. No name or alias collision.

notes: Recovered during the 2026-08-27 referent pass. The world bible is itself a reconstruction — 139 of 242 entity records carry a recovered_source naming exemption — so a name attested across eight canon files with no record behind it is material lost in reconstruction rather than a novelty awaiting admission.
